report.explanation: All current telemetry is healthy and contradicts the alert: traces OK at 70ms, error_rate 0.001, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. Deployments are 594 minutes old with valid config and cannot establish causality. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be stated; hand off for the missing alert-window evidence.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing the actual elevated error rate and latency asserted by the alert (current traces/logs/metrics show ~0.1% errors, p95 74ms, status OK)
Time-aligned metrics covering the alert window rather than a single healthy snapshot
Any error/exception logs or failing spans from gateway or order during the incident
Dependency-level telemetry (DB pool, Redis, downstream calls) to test db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency
Memory-retention time series to test memory-leak
Configuration diff or validation failure evidence to test bad-configuration
